name: 狱警

idle.desc: jail guard: navy police uniform + cap, light-blue shirt, tie; 2f bob

shock.desc: startled: eyes wide, sweat, arm flung up

india_idle.desc: Indian police (skin india): khaki uniform, navy beret, moustache, lathi held low; 2f bob

india_run.desc: Indian police running after someone: leaning forward, lathi raised overhead, shouting

india_shock.desc: Indian police startled: eyes wide, arm flung up still gripping the lathi

india_walk.desc: Indian police walk (same steps as npc_police.walk), lathi swings with the hand

read.desc: sitting on a stool reading a manga weekly; f1 page turn

portrait.desc: bust: police cap, navy uniform; f1 talking

portrait_india.desc: bust: Indian police (navy beret, moustache, khaki collar, cross strap); f1 talking

expressions.desc: bust: police cap, navy uniform; f1 talking
bust: Indian police (navy beret, moustache, khaki collar, cross strap); f1 talking

source.call: game.art_new_police_india / game.art_npc（import assets; assets.load_all(); from engine import sprite; sprite.get('npc_police.<动作>').frames）；原引擎绘制：engine.sprite.draw(img, 'npc_police.<动作>', x, y, frame=i, flip=False)

notes: 狱警（Jail guard），NPC·人物。朝向：所有帧默认朝右；朝左请水平翻转（以 pivot 的 x 为轴，见 README）。锚点语义（各动作按自己的锚点对齐到 pivot）：脚点(底部中点)=idle/walk/shock/india_idle/india_run/india_shock/india_walk/read/portrait/portrait_india。portrait* 动作是说话头像（32×32 半身）：图集里放在最后几行（按底部中点对齐，只是为了同格对齐，不代表脚点），同时逐帧导出到“头像”文件夹，见 expressions；多数 frame0=闭嘴/静态、frame1=说话/加强（具体见各自 desc），原引擎对话框打字时以 8fps 来回切换。fps 取自源码 define(fps=…) 的建议播放速度（没给的用 6），场景里实际播放速率不统一；kind（loop/oneshot/static）是按帧描述和场景用法人工标注的。
